page_title: LYO 1-0 LIL | Lyon v Lille 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+3' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Dominik Greif stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
90+1' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Abner Vinicius is replaced by Hans Hateboer (Lyon).
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Adam Karabec (Lyon) is on for Endrick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Benjamin Andre (Lille) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

88' Calvin Verdonk (Lille) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lille are going to take it.
86' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) serves up a nice cross, but Dominik Greif punches the ball away.
85' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Soriba Diaoune (Lille) replaces Tiago Santos.
85' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Francois Letexier ignores the protests.
85' Endrick (Lyon) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
84' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Tiago Santos (Lille). The referee signals a corner kick to Lille.
83' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
82' Substitution. Remi Himbert (Lyon) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pavel Sulc walks off.
82' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Ruben Kluivert (Lyon), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, well to the right of the goal.
82' There's an opportunity for Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
81' Endrick (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' Tiago Santos (Lille) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
79' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Romain Perraud walks off the pitch to be replaced by Calvin Verdonk (Lille).
77' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
76' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

74' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Berke Ozer inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
74' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
73' Referee Francois Letexier makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
73' That looked a certain handball by Aissa Mandi (Lille) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
73' Noah Nartey (Lyon) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
72' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
71' Tiago Santos (Lille) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Lille force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
70' The ball is cleared after Marius Broholm (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
68' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marius Broholm (Lille) replacing Ngalayel Mukau.
68' Today's match ends for Felix Correia who will be replaced by Olivier Giroud (Lille).
68' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
67' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
65' Felix Correia (Lille) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
64' Francois Letexier blows for a foul after Endrick (Lyon) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
63' Benjamin Andre (Lille) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Dominik Greif comes off the line to clear the ball away.
61' Francois Letexier shows the yellow card to Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) for a heavy challenge.
59' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
58' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
57' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Lille will have a chance to score from a corner.
57' Tiago Santos (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
56' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) sends a low pass into the box, towards Pavel Sulc. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
55' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
53' The Lille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
51' The resulting corner, taken by Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille), comes to nothing.
51' Felix Correia (Lille) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Now Lille have a corner.
47' Endrick (Lyon) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
46' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Francois Letexier didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
46' Endrick (Lyon) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Berke Ozer, who smothers the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Romain Perraud (Lille) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
44' Noah Nartey (Lyon) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Endrick (Lyon) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
42' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Aissa Mandi (Lille), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
42' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
41' Ruben Kluivert (Lyon) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
40' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Afonso Moreira, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
37' 1 - 0 What a goal! Ruben Kluivert plays it to Noah Nartey (Lyon), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Berke Ozer low into the middle of the net. 1:0.
35' Benjamin Andre (Lille) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
34' Romain Perraud (Lille) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
32' Romain Perraud (Lille) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
31' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Lille have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
29' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Dominik Greif acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save! Lille force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is flagged for offside.
24' The referee blows his whistle as Endrick (Lyon) was too aggressive in his challenge.
23' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
20' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) brings an opponent down and Francois Letexier interrupts the game.
18' Great teamplay by Lille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
16' Endrick (Lyon) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
16' Wow, what an escape. Abner Vinicius (Lyon) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Good work from Lyon as they win a corner.
15' Felix Correia (Lille) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
13' Romain Perraud (Lille) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Dominik Greif reacts superbly to deny him.
11' The game is interrupted now, Clinton Mata (Lyon) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
10' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
8' Dominik Greif is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Benjamin Andre (Lille). Easy save!
7' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) commits a rough foul. Francois Letexier stops the game and makes a call.
4' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes.
3' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
2' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lille will kick the game off.
Francois Letexier got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
